issue.title: Restore Cards and States as left-aligned tabs
issue.description:
Replace the current centered Cards / States Select control with a left-aligned tab control that visually and behaviorally matches the existing Workbench sidebar tabs.

Observed issue:

* Cards / States is currently implemented as a centered Select/dropdown.
* There are only two modes, so the Select adds unnecessary interaction and hides the inactive option.
* The control also feels visually disconnected from the sidebar navigation tabs.

Owner direction:

* Restore Cards / States as tabs.
* Move the control back to the left side.
* Reuse the current sidebar tab look and implementation as closely as possible.
* The result should look like the same tab component/pattern used for:
  * Colors
  * Typography
  * Effects
  * Command

Visual requirements:

* left aligned;
* same active tab background treatment as sidebar tabs;
* same typography;
* same padding;
* same radius;
* same hover/focus behavior;
* same spacing logic;
* same active/inactive visual hierarchy;
* no centered dropdown/select.

Interaction:

* Both Cards and States are always visible.
* Clicking a tab switches the preview mode immediately.
* Preserve current Cards/States behavior and content; only change the mode selector presentation/interaction surface.

Implementation preference:

* Reuse an existing shared Tabs implementation/style if one already exists.
* If sidebar tabs are currently implemented inline/custom, prefer extracting or reusing the same shared pattern rather than duplicating a second visually similar implementation.
* Keep both tab surfaces synchronized through shared classes/component logic where practical.
* Preserve shadcn-first architecture.

Do not:

* change Cards or States content;
* change preview mode semantics;
* change unrelated sidebar tabs;
* introduce another custom tab style;
* keep the old Select in parallel.

Accessibility:

* Use proper tab semantics where supported by the current shared implementation.
* Preserve keyboard navigation, focus-visible states, and selected-state announcement.
* Maintain logical DOM/focus order.

Acceptance:

* Cards / States is displayed as a left-aligned two-tab control.
* The control visually matches the sidebar Colors / Typography / Effects / Command tabs.
* Active/inactive styling is consistent between both tab surfaces.
* Cards and States remain functionally equivalent to their current modes.
* No Select/dropdown remains for this two-mode switcher.
* Keyboard/focus/accessibility behavior passes without regression.
* Shared tab styling/implementation is reused rather than duplicated where practical.
